$comment: Canonical PROPOSED geometry contract for the fictional vessel Aurora Tide (WP-02). Derived from the approved appearance reference public/cinematic/aurora-tide.webp (A-02). Values marked proposed require owner approval before final modeling. Not a real ship, not an engineering or classification document.
units: metres; x = 0 at stern transom increasing to bow, y = 0 on centreline (positive = port), z = 0 at baseline (keel)

principal.rationale: Generation brief for A-02 described ~160 m with five to six observation tiers; L/B 6.9 is typical of boutique/expedition proportions; 5.4 m draft keeps decks 1-2 below the waterline as in the concept, where only portholes appear near the water.

windowRows.type: small square portholes, sparse (crew / marina level)

shellDoors.purpose: gangway shell door (assumed, starboard mirror unseen)

decks.name: Marina
decks.use: crew mess/cabins, tender & marina embarkation, provisions

decks.name: Oceanview
decks.use: oceanview staterooms; aft lounge opening onto terrace T1
decks.observedFeature: rectangular hull windows; lowest aft terrace

decks.name: Promenade
decks.use: lifeboat/embarkation promenade, atrium, main dining aft (terrace T2), suites forward
decks.observedFeature: recessed lifeboat bay with two orange enclosed boats and liferaft canisters; first panoramic band forward

decks.name: Horizon
decks.use: panoramic balcony suites; aft lounge terrace T3

decks.name: Meridian
decks.use: panoramic balcony suites; aft pool terrace T4 with umbrellas
decks.observedFeature: third panoramic band; uppermost aft terrace with umbrellas and loungers

decks.name: Observation
decks.use: forward observation lounge + navigation bridge (forward end, assumed), spa and gym midship, funnel casing aft
decks.observedFeature: top glazed level beneath radome platform; funnel casing base with sea-glass stripe

decks.name: Sun deck
decks.use: open sun deck, radome and mast platform, funnel top
decks.observedFeature: two radomes, mast, funnel with four exhausts and louvered navy casing

superstructure.$comment: Each level is a plan footprint: aftX/foreX on centreline, side inset from the hull side, rounded aft end. Aft terraces are the open area between the hull/level below and this level's aft wall.

funnel.casing: louvered navy, swept aft, sea-glass stripe at base

accommodation.replacesDemoValues: src/lib/domain/ship.ts currently states ~1,900 guests and 14 decks, which the approved concept cannot hold
accommodation.derivation: Computed by generate.mjs (derivedCapacity) from the unit module, corridor and core rule; recorded in manifest.json. Not asserted independently.

cabin9214.conflict: Conventional numbering of the concept gives 9 decks; Deck 9 is the open sun deck, so a balcony stateroom numbered 9214 cannot exist without changing either the number or the cabin class.

options.label: Renumber the demo cabin to 7214
options.keeps: class (panoramic balcony stateroom), geometry, conventional numbering

options.label: Keep 9214 as a deck-8/9 owner's suite
options.keeps: number '9214' only if deck labels are re-based
options.changes: cabin class becomes a top-deck suite; deck labels non-conventional

options.label: Re-base deck labels (+2) so balcony bands are 'Decks 8-9'
options.changes: labels no longer match a physically plausible count below the waterline; least recommended

spatialConstraintsOptionA.module: 4.6 m wide x 7.2 m interior + 2.1 m private balcony (≈ 33 m² interior + 9.7 m² balcony)
spatialConstraintsOptionA.neighbours: 7212 aft, 7216 forward (port = even numbers; numbering restarts per zone; positions computed by generate.mjs)
spatialConstraintsOptionA.corridor: single central corridor, entry door inboard
spatialConstraintsOptionA.zones: entry & bathroom inboard, bedroom midway, living area at the glazing, balcony outboard
spatialConstraintsOptionA.exteriorRelationship: balcony faces port within the deck-7 panoramic band; glazing pattern must match the band's mullion rhythm (1.15 m)
spatialConstraintsOptionA.position: x 99-103.6 m from the stern transom, port side, outboard half-breadth 10.7 m

unseenAndAssumed: starboard side (assumed mirror, including lifeboats and shell doors)
stern transom and marina platform (only aft quarter terraces seen)
bow front, anchor pockets, mooring deck
deck 8 forward: bridge vs observation lounge split
funnel exact plan shape; mast equipment
exterior pool size/location on deck 7 aft (umbrellas observed, pool not visible)
